whyItMatters: erl_eval:expr(payload) evaluates strings as erlang code, so untrusted input reaching it becomes code injection.
actions: Replace erl_eval:expr(payload) with a fixed parser over an allowlist of operations so untrusted input stays data, never code.
If evaluation must stay, isolate it in a sandbox without file, network, or credential access.
Re-run the scan and confirm no erl_eval:expr(payload) call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no erl_eval:expr(payload) reachable from untrusted input, and injection probes stay inert data.
